title: Create a new notebook.
points: Upload both PDFs. Wait until the sources are ready.

title: Better instructions.
points: Set a short teacher instruction in Chat settings.
State audience, task, format—and ask for evidence.
note: For whom? Do what? In what format? With what limits?

title: Tell chat how
note: Point form: how many? · Table: column count + names · Steps: numbering
clear: Use a four-column table: Key point; Document statement; Teacher implication; Citation. Keep cells brief.

title: The Blueprint’s strategies.
instruction: Select both Blueprint PDFs. Copy either prompt into Chat.
prompt_en: Summarise the Blueprint’s strategies for secondary-school teachers. Use a three-column table: Strategy; Suggested teacher action; Examples. Keep cells brief. If the information is not mentioned, write 'not mentioned'. Write in English.
prompt_zh: 請為中學教師整理《藍圖》的策略，用三欄表格：推行策略、建議教師行動、例子。內容簡潔。如資料未有提及，請寫「未提及」。請以繁體中文回答。
